entries.claim: Switching the header-value scan to `flag_value_span` makes an unterminated quoted value consume the rest of the line instead of staying bounded to the credential shape.
entries.failure_scenario: A truncated line such as `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-PLANTED` or a JSON string containing the same shape will send the scan to end-of-line; `copied = span_end` then drops the closing quote/comma/next token and the egress output is structurally corrupted rather than just redacted.

counter_evidence.note: flag_value_span does not run to end of line when it finds no closer: the loop exits and it returns (inner_start, value_run_end(bytes, inner_start)), and value_run_end (:431-441) breaks on the first ASCII whitespace, quote or backslash, so an unterminated quoted value stops at the first blank. Nothing after span_end is dropped either - the loop emits line[copied..=colon] and the tail push_str(&line[copied..]) re-emits the remainder, so the closing quote, comma and following tokens all survive. Both halves are asserted at ba5de15: an_unterminated_quoted_header_value_stays_bounded keeps the trailing prose and the turn_id anchor after 'Cookie: "sid-PLANTED-Q5' with no closer, and a_header_inside_a_json_string_keeps_the_documents_punctuation asserts the output still ends 'today", "n": 1}'. Both pass.
